# Noblie Custom Knives

> > Noblie specializes in handcrafted custom knives including Damascus steel, hunting blades, pocket folders, and personalized engraved pieces with premium materials and artisan techniques.

Noblie Custom Knives is a global artisan knife maker offering bespoke and ready-made knives across multiple product categories. The site serves an international audience with support for 11 languages and features premium collections including Damascus steel, fixed blade hunters, pocket folders, and custom engraving services.

## Key Topics

- Damascus steel
- Custom knives
- Hunting knives
- Pocket knives
- Fixed blade knives
- Folding knives
- Hand-engraved knives
- EDC (Everyday Carry)
- Herman Knives
- Mosaic Damascus
- Handcrafted blades
- Knife personalization
- Premium steel (M390, M398, 1095/15N20)
- Titanium handles
- Luxury knives

## Product Collections

- [All Knives in Stock](https://nobliecustomknives.com/product-categories/all-knives): Complete knife catalog including folding, hunting, Damascus blades and collector pieces.
- [Damascus Knives](https://nobliecustomknives.com/product-categories/damascus-knives): Premium handmade Damascus knives with custom mosaic patterns and detailed specifications.
- [Mosaic Damascus Knives](https://nobliecustomknives.com/product-categories/mosaic-damascus-knives): Mosaic Damascus knives in tile, accordion, and feather patterns with premium handles.
- [Hunting Knives & Skinners](https://nobliecustomknives.com/product-categories/custom-hunting-knives): Handcrafted hunting knives including field dressing, skinning, and full-tang models.
- [Fixed Blade Knives](https://nobliecustomknives.com/product-categories/fixed-blade-knives): Master-crafted fixed blade knives for hunting, bushcraft, survival, and everyday carry.
- [Pocket & Folding Knives](https://nobliecustomknives.com/product-categories/custom-pocket-knives): Hand-forged pocket and folding knives for collectors with quality steel and fine handles.

## Specialty Knives

- [Herman Knives Collection](https://nobliecustomknives.com/product-categories/herman-knives): Herman Knives collection including Sting, Slim, Ishtar with MagnaCut and Damasteel options.
- [Hand-Engraved Knives](https://nobliecustomknives.com/product-categories/engraved-knives): Hand-engraved knives with bulino, gold/silver inlay, relief, and scrimshaw techniques.
